text:
maya: quick design review request — updated flow for Notification routing + Suppression editor ready in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/notify-suppress. Looking for UX nits and accessibility concerns before we lock the copy.

liam: skimmed — love the combined view. question: why is the threshold a slider? hard to set precise %s for SLOs. can we have both?

alina: agree with @liam. slider is great for quick checks but needs a numeric input beside it. also add a stepper for keyboard users.

maya: good call. current plan: slider for relative tuning + editable number input (inline) for exact values. will add aria-labels for the number input.

devin: suppression UI: how do we represent overlapping suppressions? the mock shows stacked chips but that feels vague. need a timeline view or at least a clear precedence rule.

jonah: suggestion — show a tiny timeline strip on hover that highlights active ranges. precedence: newest suppressions win by default, but add a toggle to "honor first match".

maya: we'll implement newest-wins default + explicit rule in help text. add a tooltip explaining precedence.

alina: accessibility nit: color contrast for the amber "warning" pill on the dark header fails AA. please use the darker amber (#B36A00) or add a 1px border. also ensure focus ring visible on keyboard nav.

liam: copy tweak — "Escalation window" reads weird in the settings panel. propose "Escalation period" or "Escalation window (minutes)". shorter labels help scanning.

maya: prefer "Escalation period" — changing in figma now.

devin: preview mode is awesome. small ask: make the preview notifications show sample payload and which channel they'd go to. e.g. show Slack channel, email subject, pager duty rule.

maya: adding a sample payload panel. want the team to review copy for the simulated message.

jonah: minor: include an "expand for full JSON" link in the preview. Lots of infra folks copy/paste that into scripts.

alina: keyboard accessibility: can we ensure the suppression date pickers are reachable and support typing? datepickers often block screen readers. fallback to text input that accepts iso dates.

maya: yup — date fields will accept typed ISO and have helper text. will add aria-describedby and aria-invalid states.

liam: one behavioral edge-case — if a suppression silences "all channels" but a route is set to "critical-only", which wins? we should define a simple decision table in the docs and surface the common case in the UI (tooltip).

maya: right — decision table: suppression overrides channel routing (silence everything) unless rule explicitly marked as "override suppression". We can hide that advanced toggle behind "advanced settings".

devin: tiny thing: the "Create rule" CTA at the bottom looks a bit lost. put it in primary color and pin it to the bottom as users scroll rules.

maya: will do. also adding a persistent "preview changes" button so you can review without closing the editor.

jonah: for copy: in notification routing dropdown change "Team" -> "Recipient group" (more accurate).

alina: screen reader note: on preview open, announce "Notification preview opened" with aria-live so users know the panel updated.

maya: noted. here's a sample preview payload we plan to show in the mock:

```json
{
  "incident_id": "INC-2026-1234",
  "severity": "critical",
  "slo": "99.9%",
  "route": "#infra-oncall",
  "suppressed": false,
  "message": "High error rate detected on inference cluster"
}
```

liam: looks good. one more UX ask: when saving a suppression that overlaps an existing one, show a short inline warning ("overlaps with existing suppression from 3/2 10:00 - 3/2 12:00") with a confirm button. avoid modal spam.

maya: inline warning + small undo toast after save. good tradeoff.

notify-bot: deployment scheduled: notify-editor/v2 -> staging at 2026-03-09T14:00Z :rocket: (automatic)

devin: playful note: can we put a small "simulated alert" playground? product folks want to demo to customers. not required for MVP but useful later.

maya: added to roadmap bucket. thanks all — I'll post updated figma + a7 accessibility checklist tomorrow for final sign-off. :pray:
